project.name: Tiresias
project.summary: An evidence-backed 5 Whys root-cause agent for financial analysts: it explains why a company's reported figures changed between SEC filings, discovers the missing evidence, and stops at the first cause the asker can act on.

zetaris.how: The evidence layer: every claim is SQL through Zetaris plus the rows it returned. In live mode every read goes through Zetaris, discovery included: the agent resolves the asked company through a Zetaris SEC tickers table, registers an unknown company's filings at runtime, and in Loop B registers the discovered spun-off entity's filings as a Lightning REST table behind a source gate, then reconciles the restatement. Live mode is measured but not yet the judge's default path (sample mode runs the same logic on cached rows), hence in-progress.
evidence: docs/measurements/live-any-company.md: live runs through local Zetaris on 2026-10-23 (three examples plus IBM, J&J, 3M, ExxonMobil, Hilton, Caterpillar, Crane NXT), cold and warm, timed from each run's phase trace lines
docs/measurements/zetaris-local.md: local bundle latencies (REST table registration 0.6–2.0 s, cached queries)
services/agent/tests/test_any_company.py: no agent module outside the sponsor adapters makes HTTP calls; live discovery and registration run as Zetaris SQL (mocked endpoint)

meterless.how: H-MEM (the Meterless reference engine, vendored unmodified, behind the cognition REST service, conformance 13/13) will store lessons from past investigations, never answers, with a memory gate and an audited purge so judges can compare cold and warm runs; the agent does not call it yet. Nightshift will be the primary model provider for all agent model calls; the client is built but not live, and the agents are rule-based for now.
evidence: services/cognition: `npm run conformance` passes the official H-MEM conformance suite 13/13 against the module the service loads
services/cognition: `npm test` (remember, recall threshold, namespaces, gate reject, purge survives restart, REST)

cursor.how: Optional since the organizers' 23 Oct 2026 update. Tiresias is built mainly with Claude Code; the Cursor IDE was used for a few manual edits. Not a dependency of the product or the build.

nvidia.how: Nemotron models served through Nightshift lanes: a fast lane for the hypothesiser and a deep lane for the critic.
